title: Controlled Capital Efficacy

arms.E0: no inherited capital — the control presentation, same section boundary, no capital of any kind
arms.E1: governed capital consumed — Proof + Reasoning + Procedure materialized through the attempt-bound pull channel before the first engineering turn

efficacyMechanism.whyHostMediated: R2-U measured voluntary uptake at 1/40 overall and 0/10 in the explicit-review capital-present arm, so a prework mechanism depending on the model choosing to pull would fail its own precondition on most runs
efficacyMechanism.channel: the worker-local pull tool and the SAME parent resolver (AllowedPullHandles + attempt-bound fetchContext); no second fetch path, no direct backing-store read, no global asset lookup
efficacyMechanism.timing: before the first engineering turn exists, so consumption-before-first-edit is structural

primaryMetric: pre-paid mistake recurrence, then mechanical outcome (full solve) per arm

verdictCriteria.REPLICATED: both scenarios: E1 repeats the pre-paid mistake less often than E0 AND E1 mechanical outcome is not worse, with every analysed E1 trial having consumed all selected capital
verdictCriteria.PARTIAL: exactly one scenario shows clear benefit, or both show weak/noisy directional benefit
verdictCriteria.NOT_OBSERVED: neither scenario shows meaningful benefit despite guaranteed capital consumption

notAnUptakeStage: R2-E removes voluntary uptake as a variable. R2-U remains the uptake result and this stage must not be converted into one.

frozenPriorEvidence.onePuller: solved its Scenario-C task, but n=1 and self-selected, so that is association only

indexHypothesisCarriedForward.statement: kind + opaque identity + handle does not provide enough expected-value information for a worker to decide that pull is worth its cost
indexHypothesisCarriedForward.status: RECORDED, NOT IMPLEMENTED — actionable only if R2-E establishes capital efficacy
